# Qefro

> Connect your business software to AI-powered customer conversations and automation.

Keep your ERP. Keep your business applications. Add Qefro.

Qefro is not another ERP, CRM replacement, or generic chatbot. It is the AI customer interaction and automation layer that connects existing business software to customers.

## Architecture

Existing Business Software → Qefro → AI Chat + WhatsApp + CRM + Automation → Your customers

## Layers

- **Connect** — SDK, Marketplace apps, external webhooks, and business events
- **Engage** — Website chat, WhatsApp, voice, multilingual conversations, live business data
- **Automate** — CRM automation from business events (WhatsApp, email, tags, assignment, follow-ups, tasks)

## Product surfaces

- Customer 360 (relationship in Qefro; business records stay in connected apps)
- CRM around people, conversations, tags, notes, status, assignment
- Business event automation (examples: quotation.created, order.created — configurable, not hardcoded)
- WhatsApp and website chat with live business data
- Qefro SDK capabilities vs business events
- Marketplace connectors for software customers already use

Customer support chat is one channel into the customer layer — not the definition of Qefro.
